plan: Given my value of $49, a rational strategy is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a high chance of winning. Since values are uniformly distributed and all bidders are rational, others will likely bid close to their values too. Bidding slightly below $49, such as $48.9, balances winning probability and profit margin.

Given my private value of $44, I should bid just below my value to maximize profit if I win, while not overbidding and risking a loss. Rational bidders will bid close to their values. To win, I should bid slightly above the expected average value, around $24.5. To balance winning chances and profit, I bid slightly above this but below my value.

Given my value of $22, I should bid slightly below this value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Bidding exactly my value is risky since rational bidders will bid below their value. To balance winning and profit, I will bid $21.9, which is close enough to my value to win against slightly lower bids but still leaves room for profit if I win.
